input_size.description: Sets the total size of the input stream to enable progress bar mode. Corresponds to -s.

block_size.description: Size of blocks in bytes to move through the program at once. Can have suffixes K, M, G. Corresponds to -b.

max_block_size.description: Maximum block size for adaptive block sizing. Corresponds to -m.

interval.description: Number of seconds between updates on speed/progress bar. Corresponds to -i.

input_files.description: List of input file paths to read from. If empty, defaults to /dev/stdin. Corresponds to -f or positional args.

adaptive_block_sizing_disabled.description: Turns off adaptive block sizing. Corresponds to -a.

logging_mode_enabled.description: Turns on logging mode (newlines only). Corresponds to -l.

report_mode_enabled.description: Enable report-only mode, suppressing normal output. Corresponds to -r.
